name: Hyline Orchard
description: Hyline Orchard is a working farm in Fish Creek, WI. It grows Raspberries, Apples, Cherries, Pumpkins, and Corn, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
